metaDescription: Order custom folding lanyards badges for easy badge access. Perfect for trade shows and daily ID use. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Folding lanyards and badges offer a compact solution for badge storage and quick retrieval. Unlike standard lanyards, these feature a retractable mechanism that keeps badges secure when not in use and extends them with a simple pull. Ideal for busy environments like hospitals, warehouses, or trade shows where hands-free badge scanning is needed. Choose from nylon or polyester webbing, and add your logo with screen printing or debossing.
heroAltText: Custom folding lanyards and badges with retractable badge holder and printed logo on nylon webbing
